result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. I haven't added a test for this case. I ran the `Landscape*` tests in `codeanalyzer` and they passed, but I don't know whether any of them cover the remainder team.

The change is one extra condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeContributorsAggregator.java`. A contributor who matches no team is added to the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true. Dormant unmatched contributors are skipped.

Contributors with a blank latest-commit date already count as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` returns true for a blank date, so nobody is dropped for missing data. Configured teams go through `addToTeams`, which I didn't touch, so they keep all their members.
